messages:
Sam: heads up — noticed a sharp LCP jump and repeated chart frame drops in canary (main dashboard, eu-region). Perf dashboard: https://internal.redwood/dash/abcd1234 — looks like ~800ms -> 2.4s on initial chart paint :grimace:
Tasha: saw that too, traced a few traces. Main culprit seems to be a new telemetry client bundle pulling in a large date/intl helper and also bundling chart-utils twice. flame: https://trace/xyz -> big block in parse/module-eval
Mike: yep the telemetry PR (PR#6521) added a FormatDate util from intl-helpers that drags in ~180KB gzip. Also noticed chart-embedder v3.2 now bundles its own tiny-format lib instead of relying on shared util => duplication
Julia: is the regression from the telemetry import itself or the way webpack split chunks? canary trace shows a sync import early in bootstrap
Tasha: it's sync. PR changed telemetry init to run during appStart to attach user context earlier. That means it is in the critical path now
Keven: also worth noting routing change from last week is routing chart data requests via analytics-proxy for sampling. That increased TTFB for data fetches by ~120ms which amplifies perceived slowness because charts wait for data then render heavy layout
Sam: so two orthogonal regressions: (1) client bundle inflation + duplicate util, (2) backend routing proxy adding TTFB. Both combine to spike LCP and cause frameskips
Mike: quick mitigation ideas: lazy-import telemetry (defer until after firstpaint) OR dynamic import the FormatDate util only when charts mount. Example quick patch: 
```
// lazy init (sketch)
window.requestIdleCallback(() => import('pkg/telemetry').then(m => m.init()));
// or in chart component
const fmt = await import('intl-helpers').then(m => m.format);
```
Tasha: I can prototype the chart-side lazy import in a 10m patch and measure. If that cuts ~150KB from critical path we should see improvement
Keven: on the proxy side we can add a bypass rule for /charts/data for internal dashboard routes to avoid analytics-proxy. SRE flagged that route as low risk earlier. I'll open a policy rollback ticket if you want to try it in canary first
Julia: prefer to fix client-side first so we don't change routing surface under load. Could also gate telemetry by rollout flag and revert to old init for canary users
Mike: PR incoming for telemetry lazy-init: https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/6622 — it's a small dynamic import + fallback. I'll also add a webpack tweak to ensure intl-helpers are in vendors chunk not repeated
SRE-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy started for sha:deadbeef — watchlist: perf-main-dashboard, chart-streams. Status: in-progress :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Sam: great. Tasha — after your quick patch can you run the synthetic LCP job and post numbers? Want before/after and trace link
Tasha: will do. Targeting a canary push in 30m. If numbers look good we can promote and then decide on proxy rollback as a follow-up
Keven: I'll prepare the routing rollback ticket but won't apply unless we see client patch doesn't restore SLOs
Mike: note — we should also add a telemetry sampling filter to avoid heavy formatting for anonymous telemetry in the critical path. That reduces init work for most users
Julia: and add a console rollout note for UX team — changes might affect early metrics. We should keep a short blurb in #product-rollouts so PMs are aware
Sam: owner list: Sam (coordinator), Mike (telemetry patch), Tasha (chart lazy-import experiment), Keven (routing rollback ready), Julia (release notes). Re-check in 45m
Tasha: quick update (15m): chart lazy-import patched, synthetic LCP job shows 2.4s -> 1.1s on canary. Trace: https://trace/xyz/after — big reduction in main thread parse and module init
Mike: amazing. I'll land the telemetry PR but keep it feature-flagged so we can revert quickly if needed
SRE-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy complete for sha:beefdead — smoke checks passed
Sam: thanks team — leaving the routing rollback ticket in Keven's queue but we can close if no further regressions after full rollout. Follow-up: add bundling check to CI to catch duplicate utils (size delta alert)
Keven: filed ticket RW-issue-905 for routing fallback policy and RW-issue-906 for CI bundle-size guard
Julia: adding short note to product channel now. :thumbsup:
Sam: closing thread for now — ping if anything spikes back up
